current_state.zh: 美国9月CPI数据高于预期，核心CPI环比0.33%的细节进一步强化了美联储年内再次加息的理由，市场关注加息时点可能在两周后会议或12月。
current_state.en: U.S. September CPI came in hotter than expected, with core CPI rising 0.33% m/m, reinforcing the case for another Fed rate hike this year; timing uncertainty remains between the next meeting and December.

updates.title_zh: 美国9月CPI全面超出预期，年率升至3.7%，高位
updates.title_en: U.S. September CPI Broadly Exceeds Expectations, Annual Rate Rises to 3.7%, High
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国9月CPI高于预期，整体通胀同比为3.7%，核心通胀为2.6%，均为数月来最高读数。
updates.what_changed_en: U.S. September CPI came in above expectations, with headline inflation at 3.7% year over year and core at 2.6%, both the highest readings in months.

updates.title_zh: 「美联储传声筒」：通胀高于预期，进一步支持美联储年内再加息
updates.title_en: 「美联储传声筒」：通胀高于预期，进一步支持美联储年内再加息
updates.what_changed_zh: 9月核心CPI环比上涨0.33%，高于预期，前值为0.29%；「美联储传声筒」Timiraos称这强化了美联储年内再次加息的理由，并引发对加息时机的讨论。
updates.what_changed_en: September core CPI rose 0.33% month-over-month, hotter than expected, versus 0.29% prior; WSJ's Nick Timiraos said this reinforces the case for another Fed rate hike this year and raises timing questions.

updates.current_state_en: U.S. September CPI came in hotter than expected, with core CPI rising 0.33% m/m, reinforcing the case for another Fed rate hike this year; timing uncertainty remains between the next meeting and December.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: WSJ's Nick Timiraos said September core CPI came in hotter than expected at 0.33% month-over-month, reinforcing the case for another Fed rate hike this year and raising the question of whether officials move in two weeks or wait until December.
